title: Shark wearing a party hat
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <linearGradient id='body' x1='0' y1='0' x2='0' y2='1'>
      <stop offset='0' stop-color='#5aa9e6'/>
      <stop offset='1' stop-color='#3a7fc4'/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id='belly' x1='0' y1='0' x2='0' y2='1'>
      <stop offset='0' stop-color='#eaf4ff'/>
      <stop offset='1' stop-color='#c6e0f7'/>
    </linearGradient>
  </defs>
  <!-- tail -->
  <polygon points='14,52 2,34 6,58 2,74 16,60' fill='#5aa9e6' stroke='#8fd0ff' stroke-width='1.5' stroke-linejoin='round'/>
  <!-- dorsal fin -->
  <polygon points='46,30 58,12 64,32' fill='#4a90d0' stroke='#8fd0ff' stroke-width='1.5' stroke-linejoin='round'/>
  <!-- pectoral fin -->
  <polygon points='44,58 38,74 56,66' fill='#4a90d0' stroke='#8fd0ff' stroke-width='1.5' stroke-linejoin='round'/>
  <!-- body -->
  <path d='M16 56 C20 38 34 30 52 30 C72 30 86 40 90 54 C86 68 72 76 52 76 C34 76 20 70 16 56 Z' fill='url(#body)' stroke='#8fd0ff' stroke-width='1.5'/>
  <!-- belly -->
  <path d='M30 68 C40 74 60 74 74 66 C68 72 60 75 52 75 C42 75 34 72 30 68 Z' fill='url(#belly)'/>
  <!-- mouth line -->
  <path d='M60 58 C72 58 84 56 89 53 C83 58 74 62 62 63' fill='#c6e0f7' stroke='#c6e0f7' stroke-width='2' stroke-linejoin='round'/>
  <!-- teeth -->
  <polygon points='72,57 74,62 76,57' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <polygon points='78,56 80,61 82,56' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <!-- eye -->
  <circle cx='66' cy='44' r='6' fill='#ffffff' stroke='#8fd0ff' stroke-width='1.5'/>
  <circle cx='67' cy='45' r='3' fill='#12395e'/>
  <circle cx='68' cy='43.5' r='1' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <!-- gill -->
  <path d='M56 44 C58 50 58 56 55 62' fill='none' stroke='#2c6aa8' stroke-width='1.8' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M50 44 C52 50 52 56 49 62' fill='none' stroke='#2c6aa8' stroke-width='1.8' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- party hat -->
  <polygon points='56,30 66,6 78,26' fill='#ff4d6d' stroke='#ffb3c4' stroke-width='1.5' stroke-linejoin='round'/>
  <circle cx='66' cy='5' r='3.5' fill='#ffe14d' stroke='#fff3b0' stroke-width='1'/>
  <path d='M59 24 L74 20' fill='none' stroke='#ffe14d' stroke-width='2.5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M62 16 L72 13' fill='none' stroke='#4dd2ff' stroke-width='2.5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <circle cx='63' cy='21' r='1.6' fill='#4dd2ff'/>
  <circle cx='70' cy='18' r='1.6' fill='#ffe14d'/>
</svg>
